scheme_name: Assistance for Purchase of Spectacles - Folk Artists
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered folk artist
Applicant should not have any dues payable to the board
Applicant must not have availed similar benefits from any other government scheme
Assistance limited to the first 2,000 registered folk artists per year on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis
Benefit is given only once per applicant
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹500 for purchase of spectacles, provided once per applicant.
